name: 65101 · Jefferson Cty, MO
findings: ZIP 65101 (Jefferson Cty) has 256 nonprofit organizations. 124 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 113 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65101 (Jefferson Cty) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 65101 (Jefferson Cty) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).
